root.label: Christopher Waller speech on forward guidance

events.label: Christopher Waller speech on forward guidance

slots.name: job vacancies to unemployed workers ratio
slots.sentence: In particular, the combination of a negative labor supply shock along with a booming economy fueled by fiscal and monetary stimulus led to a situation in early 2022 where the ratio of job vacancies to unemployed workers was 2—a level never seen before.

slots.name: inflation target for liftoff
slots.sentence: A case in point is the forward guidance the FOMC adopted in September 2020 when it said that liftoff from the effective lower bound would occur when conditions were consistent with maximum employment and when inflation had risen to 2 percent and was "on track to moderately exceed 2 percent for some time."

slots.name: two-year Treasury yield increase
slots.sentence: Even though we did not change the policy rate until March 2022, from September 2021 through mid-February, the two-year Treasury yield rose nearly 200 basis points.

slots.name: monetary policy transmission lag reduction
slots.sentence: That rise effectively shaved off about 6 months from the usual 12- to 24-month lag that one might conjecture would be needed to see the 200 basis points of actual tightening affect the economy.
